mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and hepatotoxic; amikacin causes dose-dependent renal damage while pyrazinamide causes hepatotoxicity and hyperuricemia, increasing risk of acute kidney injury and drug accumulation.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and hepatic function (LFTs) regularly; adjust amikacin dosing based on renal clearance; consider alternative agents if possible, particularly in patients with pre-existing renal or hepatic impairment.
